title: Zebra in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f0e6d2'/>

  <path d='M38 50 Q40 60 36 74' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M62 50 Q64 60 60 74' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='60' y='72' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f0e6d2'/>

  <path d='M38 48 Q36 40 37 32' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 44 Q32 36 34 30' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M30 46 Q38 50 46 46 L45 52 Q37 55 30 51 Z' fill='#e85a4f'/>

  <path d='M44 50 Q52 54 50 62' stroke='#ff8a70' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='22' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f0e6d2'/>

  <path d='M28 14 Q30 22 27 30' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 13 Q35 22 33 31' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 14 Q41 22 39 29' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='26' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d4c8b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='26' rx='1.5' ry='1.5' fill='#4a3a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='26' rx='1.5' ry='1.5' fill='#4a3a5a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M26 12 Q24 4 28 6 Q30 10 29 13' fill='#f0e6d2'/>
  <path d='M26 12 Q25 7 28 8' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 12 Q44 4 42 8 Q40 11 39 13' fill='#f0e6d2'/>
  <path d='M40 12 Q42 7 41 9' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M28 14 L30 10 L33 15 L36 10 L39 14' stroke='#5a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#4a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='33.5' cy='19.5' r='0.8' fill='#f0e6d2'/>
</svg>
